## Overview

A [`SimulationExperiment`](SimulationExperiments.qmd) is defined declaratively in YAML. Its components are documented under the **Specify an Experiment** part of the guide:

| Component | Documented under |
|-----------|------------------|
| [Networks](Networks/Network.qmd) | *Networks & Connectomes* — regions, weights, tract lengths |
| [Output](Observation/Output.qmd) | *Observation models* — declarative simulation outputs |
| [Algorithms](Fitting/Algorithms.qmd) | *Fitting, inference & optimization* — built-in tuning algorithms (e.g. FIC) |
| [Loss Functions](Fitting/LossFunction.qmd) | *Fitting, inference & optimization* — symbolic loss functions |
